exposure: contemporary definition of postpartum hemorrhage (>1000 mL regardless of delivery mode)
traditional definition of postpartum hemorrhage (>500 mL for vaginal delivery and >1000 mL for cesarean delivery)
cohort: Women who delivered at a tertiary-level academic medical center between July 2017 and June 2018
finding: In this study population, intrapartum administration of magnesium sulfate was not found to be an independent risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Intrapartum administration of magnesium sulfate was not found to be an independent risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage.
